lines.trans: Why are you so irritated today?
It is very strange to me that he does not call.
Who exactly are you talking about now?
I am talking about my husband Ivan.
And what is so strange about that?
I know him very well after all.
Usually he should either shout loudly.
Or he should ask for forgiveness.
And now for some reason he is simply silent.
Well it is good that he is silent.
What if something happened to him?
Stop talking foolish nonsense.
What a heartless person you are after all!
I will go home and check on him!

examples.trans: What a heartless person you are!
I grew up in a communal flat.
Why did it suddenly draw level?

meanings.en: after all, still, all the same

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: поставить громко = to put a phone on speaker

examples.text: Не говорите так громко, дети спят.
examples.trans: Don't speak so loudly, the children are asleep.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.
That's nothing, I even like it.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

звонить.gloss: to call, to phone; to ring

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

молчать.gloss: to be silent, to say nothing

meanings.en: to be silent, to keep quiet
meanings.note: почему ты молчишь? = why aren't you saying anything?
goes right before the word it negates
+ prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: А в каких местах он обычно пьёт?
examples.trans: And in what places does he usually drink?

examples.text: Он обычно встаёт в семь утра.
examples.trans: He usually gets up at seven in the morning.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

meanings.note: перестань(те)! = stop it!, oh come on!

examples.text: Да перестаньте! Я двадцать лет в карты не играла.
examples.trans: Oh, stop it! I haven't played cards for twenty years.

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)

examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?
And now for some reason he is silent.

meanings.note: takes the accusative; everyday synonym of о

examples.trans: He says nasty things about me.

meanings.en: to check, to test, to verify

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness
просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness, apologise

examples.trans: He is asking me to forgive him.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.

meanings.note: я что-то вижу = I see something
colloquial, used as an adverb: что-то я не вижу = somehow I don't see it

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
